permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connect to your own Mac relay for transcription, messages, and photos you choose to send to your existing Dot.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: When hold-to-record is enabled, hold to record up to 30 seconds. With voice activation on, Dot Link keeps the G2 microphone open while active and detects the cue on your phone. Only speech after the cue is sent for transcription.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: When enabled, share your phone's location with your Dot through your Mac. Your Mac caches nearby map data, which can reveal past areas, until unused for 30 days. You can stop sharing anytime.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Take a photo when you tap the camera button. Attach it to your draft and send it with Send, or after voice input when automatic sending is enabled.

permissions.name: album
permissions.desc: Choose photos for your draft. Selected photos go to your own Dot through your Mac with Send, or after voice input when automatic sending is enabled.
